title: Flippant
summary: FLIP'PANT, adjective [Latin labor, to slide or slip, and to liber, free.] 1. Of smoother, fluent and rapid speech; speaking with ease and rapidity; having a voluble tongue; talkative. 2. Pert; petulan

inlines.v: FLIP'PANT, adjective [Latin labor, to slide or slip, and to liber, free.] 1. Of smoother, fluent and rapid speech; speaking with ease and rapidity; having a voluble tongue; talkative. 2. Pert; petulant; waggish. Away with flippant epilogues.
